interpretation.plan_claim: Every plan pair keeps 1,200 instructions and identical resources; the SASS delta is limited to one failure-only assertion source-line immediate.
interpretation.raw_cubin_sha_note: Raw cubin SHA can differ while exact SASS and resource usage match because non-executable ELF/string-table content can differ.
interpretation.return_claim: Every same-label return pair has exact SASS and resource usage.
interpretation.source_claim: Every source pair changes from 1,352 to 1,384 static SASS instructions, matching the bounded lookup implementation.

tool.sass_hash_definition: SHA256 over exact cuobjdump --dump-sass stdout bytes; no normalization.
